summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, announcing the appointment of Karine Pinto-Flomenboim as CFO, effective August 9, 2026, succeeding Guy Nathanzon who is stepping down on July 13, 2026. Yael Rozenberg, VP Finance, will serve as interim CFO during the transition. No terms, price, premium, or advisor are mentioned as this is a routine executive succession, not a contested departure or activist-driven change. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report (equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K for management changes). What to watch: The transition appears orderly, but any further departures or strategic shifts could signal deeper issues.
